cards.title: Primary path — login → scrape → cache
items: POST /scraper/login runs portal_client.scrapper() in-process: no browser, four plain HTTP requests (~9 MB, ~1–2 s) replaying the portal's own ASP.NET WebForms submits.
Sequence: GET login form for the RSA public key → CHECKCOLLEGE pre-check (USN plaintext, password RSA-encrypted) → POST RSA-encrypted login → GET timetable + POST attendance summary.
Parsed JSON is upserted into attendance, one attendance_history checkpoint is appended, and a 7-day JWT is returned in the same response.
Failures are masked: bad credentials → 401, transport or unexpected HTML → 502 'Portal unavailable'.

cards.title: Reads & caching (return path, not drawn)
items: GET /fetch_attendance and /fetch_attendance/history verify the Bearer JWT and serve the cached PostgreSQL row — the portal is contacted only during login.
There is no rate limit, TTL, or quota: every login really re-scrapes (README: 'Rate Limiting — There are none').
The SPA keeps the token and last payload in localStorage, so returning users render from cache while the network request is in flight.

cards.title: Trust & credential handling
items: Portal passwords are never stored: used once inside the scrape, then dropped — no server-side sessions, no browser persistence; refreshing data means logging in again.
httpx INFO logging is suppressed in main.py so the pre-check URL (USN + RSA'd password) never reaches journalctl.
JWTs are HS256-signed with JWT_SECRET_KEY (7-day expiry); validation errors return a generic 422 that never echoes request values; CORS is an explicit allowlist.
Leaderboard exposes alias, percentage, branch and rank only — USNs and raw records never leave the database.

cards.title: Admin review queue — secondary flow
items: Panel credentials are typed on the normal login form; the SPA keeps them in sessionStorage (per-tab only) and sends them as X-Admin-Auth alongside the JWT.
require_admin is a double gate: 503 if unconfigured, 403 for a non-admin USN, constant-time compare for panel user and password.

Donation proofs are capped at 5 MB, content-sniffed as images, and written under uploads/donations with server-generated names — outside the web root and never served statically; the private admin_note is never published.

cards.title: Ownership & operations
items: Frontend: Vercel builds frontend/ on push to main; VITE_API_URL points the browser at the backend public URL.
Backend: uvicorn under systemd on an Ubuntu server (Dockerfile also provided); `alembic upgrade head` runs before each restart.
Database: PostgreSQL 18 on AWS, reached over postgresql:// built in backend/api/config.py — hence the off-host boundary.
Known fragility: the scraper mirrors the portal's HTML structure; portal availability gates the entire login path.
